summary: Scroll snap makes a scrolling container stop with an item lined up, instead of anywhere in between. Put scroll-snap-type on the container and scroll-snap-align on each item.
notes: scroll-snap-type: x mandatory means sideways scrolling always comes to rest on a card. proximity would only snap when you stop close to one.
width: 70% shows part of the next card. That edge tells people there is more to scroll.
scroll-behavior: smooth is only turned on when the person has not asked for reduced motion.
pitfall: Putting scroll-snap-type on the cards instead of the scrolling container. Nothing snaps, and there is no error.
